articles.title: Bill Gates: « I will always choose a lazy person to do a difficult job »
articles.standfirst: The well-known quote holds that he would choose a lazy person to tackle a difficult job because they would find an easy way to solve it.
articles.summary: The well-known quote holds that he would choose a lazy person to tackle a difficult job because they would find an easy way to solve it.
articles.body:
"The phrase has become one of the best-known reflections on productivity, effort, and ingenuity attributed to Bill Gates . The full version adds that this lazy person will find a simple way to do it.

The idea starts from a paradox: whoever receives a complicated task may devote many hours to the usual procedure, while whoever tries to reduce the effort looks from the outset for an alternative to reach the same result.

Technology and automation

This phrase has become one of the best-known reflections on productivity, effort, and ingenuity. It does not necessarily mean working worse, but rather asking whether there is a different way to do what one has been tasked with.

The theory is based on the idea that a person who seeks to avoid unnecessary work may be forced to think in a different way and find a much more efficient procedure

Automating processes, eliminating unnecessary steps, or designing tools that solve a task in seconds are common strategies in technology companies. The key, he indicates, lies in achieving the objective with resources in a smarter way.

Gates built much of his career around technology and the creation of tools to make tasks easier. Microsoft, founded by him and Paul Allen in 1975 , turned software into a tool that became increasingly present in homes, businesses, and educational centers. One of the major changes in computing was automating tasks that previously required a great deal of manual work, and today this is growing even more with Copilot AI. From spreadsheets to word processors, many digital tools were created with a very specific purpose: to make simpler what previously required more time and effort.

The trail of the expression goes further back. Clarence E. Bleicher, then president of Chrysler's DeSoto division, testified on January 31, 1947, before the U.S. Senate Committee on Labor and Public Welfare.

' Bleicher said that, when faced with a difficult job for which there was no simple method, he would put a lazy man in charge , because within ten days he would have an easy way to do it. To Senator Ellender, who asked him why he would choose a lazy man rather than a hardworking one, he replied that "the lazy man will find an easy way to do it."'

The wording recorded in that intervention does not literally match the quote that circulates under Gates's name. It does, however, share the central idea: assigning a complicated task to someone who will seek to reduce the effort needed to solve it.

articles.title: Eva Longoria cleans her pool in a floor-length gown and somehow makes housework glamorous
articles.summary: Eva Longoria is finally doing housework, but apparently she only does it when she looks ready for the red carpet.
articles.body:
Eva Longoria is finally doing housework, but apparently she only does it when she looks ready for the red carpet.

The 51-year-old actress shared a playful video of herself cleaning a swimming pool while wearing an elegant, floor-length white gown. With the Los Angeles skyline behind her, Longoria carefully worked around the water without sacrificing an ounce of glamour.

“20 years later and I’m finally doing housework,” she joked in the caption, instantly reminding fans of Gabrielle Solis, her famously glamorous character from “Desperate Housewives.” Two decades later, Longoria proved that even pool maintenance can become a fashion moment when you choose the right outfit.

articles.title: Lewis Hamilton shows Kim Kardashian their quiet side in photos filled with extravagant dates
articles.standfirst: An outdoor movie theater and a cruise past the Eiffel Tower drew attention, but their London bike ride may be the most revealing moment in his latest post
articles.summary: An outdoor movie theater and a cruise past the Eiffel Tower drew attention, but their London bike ride may be the most revealing moment in his latest post
articles.body:
Lewis Hamilton could have led with the champagne cruise. Instead, the first image in his September 22 Instagram carousel shows him taking a selfie with Kim Kardashian during a bike ride. His caption is just as casual: “Bit of this, bit of that.”

The rest of the post moves between very different kinds of dates. There is an outdoor movie setup with a large screen, rattan trays and a cart stocked with desserts. In Paris, champagne sits aboard a boat on the Seine with the Eiffel Tower in view ; later, Hamilton films the landmark sparkling after dark. He did not identify where the movie night took place.

The bike ride tells another part of the story

Hamilton and Kardashian rode Lime bikes with friends in London on September 18, while Kardashian was in the city for the opening of a Skims store on Regent Street. Two people whose lives usually unfold around cameras, premieres and international travel spent part of the day doing something almost ordinary. That contrast makes the selfie stand out among the more elaborate images.

Their next public appearance was far more formal. On September 19, both attended the opening-night celebration of the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art in Los Angeles. Hamilton’s carousel ends with a photograph from inside the museum, quietly connecting another shared evening to the dates he chose to show his followers.

The couple confirmed their relationship on Instagram in April, after dating reports began earlier in the year. Since then, they have shared glimpses of trips together, including time with family. The new carousel does not announce another milestone or explain where the relationship is headed.

What it does show is how Hamilton chose to tell this part of their story : a bike ride first, then the movie screen, Paris at sunset and a night out in Los Angeles. The grand gestures are there, but the image he used to open the post is simply the two of them together on a bike.

articles.title: Lindsey Vonn confirms her relationship with French skier Matthieu Bailet, 11 years younger
articles.standfirst: The American Olympic champion made the relationship public through a series of photographs from their vacation. Bailet, 30, and Vonn, 41, had been seen together in New York in May.
articles.summary: The American Olympic champion made the relationship public through a series of photographs from their vacation. Bailet, 30, and Vonn, 41, had been seen together in New York in May.
articles.body:
"L indsey Vonn , the 41-year-old American, posted several photos on Instagram from her summer vacation in which she appears alongside the 30-year-old athlete, putting an end to the rumors that had arisen months earlier.

Vonn accompanied the images with the message "It's about time to do a summer recap… part 1❤️". Bailet responded to the post with an "I can't wait to see the second part of the summer recap😉😘". Among the photographs, the two appear together in a swimming pool, in the sea, and during different moments of their vacation.

A relationship that had already generated rumors

The relationship had begun to be publicly discussed in May, when Vonn and Bailet were seen together in New York. Both were photographed while shopping in the SoHo neighborhood, riding the subway, and posing together backstage at the Broadway musical The Outsiders. A source cited at the time explained that they were “getting to know each other better”.

Those appearances took place during Vonn's visit to New York for the Met Gala . The American had also left a comment on one of Bailet's Instagram posts, fueling speculation about a possible relationship between the two alpine skiing specialists.

Bailet, born in Nice, is a French skier specializing in speed events. He made his World Cup debut in March 2016 , in St. Moritz, and competed in the Beijing 2022 Olympic Games. In March 2026, he also competed in the World Cup finals in Kvitfjell, Norway.

For Vonn, this is her first known relationship since her breakup with Diego Osorio . The skier confirmed in February 2025 the end of her several-year relationship with the businessman. “This year, Valentine’s Day will be a little different for me. But I have my two dogs, so they will be my companions for the day.”, she explained at the time.

Vonn, also focused on her recovery

The announcement comes months after Vonn's return to the 2026 Winter Olympics . The American suffered a serious crash during the downhill event in Cortina d"Ampezzo and had to undergo several surgical procedures. Her recovery has shaped much of her activity over the past few months.

"In May, Vonn explained that she hoped to take advantage of the summer to disconnect after the months following the injury. “I want to have a great summer and I need to disconnect a little from everything”, said the Olympic champion, who at the time was getting around with crutches and a cane.

The September post shows that Bailet was part of that summer. Although the couple had already been publicly linked during the spring, the photographs shared by Vonn constitute the first direct confirmation of the relationship by the skier. Bailet also shared the post on his Instagram stories.

articles.title: The drama surrounding Sydney Sweeney's advert gets an epic response: “The world will keep turning”
articles.standfirst: Charley Hull dismissed the idea that every image needs a deeper meaning
articles.summary: Charley Hull dismissed the idea that every image needs a deeper meaning
articles.body:
Charley Hull has stepped into the debate surrounding Sydney Sweeney ’s controversial Novig campaign with a characteristically blunt message being, people are overthinking it.

The golf star weighed in after a wave of criticism from female athletes who argued that Sweeney’s sports-themed advert sexualized women and distracted from the athleticism of women’s sport. Hull sees it differently.

“My opinion on the @sydney_sweeney advert? People are genuinely getting pissed off because an actress/model is… modelling in an advert. ???? That is quite literally her job,” Hull wrote on Instagram.

“Not everything needs a 45-minute psychological breakdown and a public inquiry,” Hull added. “Sometimes a pretty woman in an advert is just a pretty woman in an advert. The world will keep spinning, I promise. ????"

Issue goes beyond Sweeney herself

The Novig campaign features Sweeney posing with sports equipment while promoting the company’s “Just Sports” branding.

That imagery drew criticism from a number of prominent female athletes, who said the campaign blurred the line between promoting sport and sexualizing women connected to it.

World champion boxer Skye Nicolson was among those to respond, writing: “Respectfully Sydney Sweeney, This is sport… Stop sexualizing women in sport.”

Other athletes, including Ariarne Titmus, Amy Hunt, Sophie Capewell, Lisa Neumann, Ellie Boatman and Tilly Kearns , also joined the broader backlash.

One athlete wrote: “How do we live in a world where monetizing a woman’s body and sexualizing women’s sport is still a thing?”

Another argued that young girls need to understand that “attention and value are not the same thing,” warning that appearance can bring likes, money and opportunities without necessarily reflecting achievement.

Novig pushes back on criticism

Novig co-founder Jacob Fortinsky has defended the campaign and said the company was not trying to depict women’s sport.

“As a company, we’re hugely supportive of women’s sports,” Fortinsky said. “We never intended to portray female sports.”

He also stressed that Sweeney was appearing in her role as an actress.

“Sydney’s an actress,” Fortinsky added. “We’re a prediction market that is focused on sports, and that was the story she was communicating.”

Sweeney , who is also a strategic partner and equity holder in Novig, has not directly addressed the criticism.

She appeared to respond indirectly by sharing images from ESPN’s former “Body Issue” shoots featuring professional athletes.

Hull ’s intervention adds another prominent voice to the dispute, but from the opposite side.

Critics see the campaign as part of a broader pattern in which women’s sport is reduced to image and sexuality.

Hull ’s view is that an actress posed for an advert, and not every campaign needs to become a referendum on women’s sport.

articles.title: The billionaire YouTuber MrBeast claims that he spent $10 million building a village in Ghana.
articles.standfirst: The project replaces a school without doors or windows that was attended by more than 300 children. It also includes drainage, solar panels, and a community farm.
articles.summary: The project replaces a school without doors or windows that was attended by more than 300 children. It also includes drainage, solar panels, and a community farm.
articles.body:
Jimmy Donaldson, known as MrBeast, posted a video this weekend showing how a village was built in Ghana . According to him, the investment was 10 million dollars.

The village is called Abna Dakwa and the construction work lasted eight months. Donaldson explained that the goal is to keep children and families out of illegal labor. He also wrote that his 14-year career on YouTube had been the path to this project.

Houses, school, and drainage for an already existing village

A school without doors or windows is replaced by a new one. Before the construction, more than 300 children attended a school without windows or doors and with a dirt floor. When it rained, the building flooded and the students stopped going. Many have to walk several kilometers to get there, in surroundings that the video shows as dirty and with sweltering heat.

To curb flooding, the team built drains that also prevent water from blocking access to the village. The residents requested a community center, a farm, and a water well. All three were built, along with a market, sanitation facilities, and homes. Solar panels were also installed to generate electricity.

The school will provide free meals to students for five years, with the intention that the children and their families remain in the education system. The children themselves designed their playground.

The project adds a soccer field . As stated in the video, the idea is that the next Messi or the next Ronaldo could come from there.

Homes with solar panels and running water

The other focus of the project is the villagers' homes. According to the video, the houses were built with running water, a service they had not had until now . Consumption was one of the most problematic issues in the village, where its inhabitants were becoming ill on a large scale due to the lack of drinking water.

Solar panels were also installed to generate electricity for the village. That supply is added to the drainage system and the well, which complete the settlement’s basic infrastructure works.

Before premiering the video, Donaldson warned on X that the content would not have a broad reach. "It probably won't do very well, but it's something I care deeply about and I hope my passion shows", he wrote. One follower even pointed out in a comment that his humanitarian videos usually get fewer views than the rest.

'The YouTuber responded: "It’s funny when they say I only help people for the views, because it’s exactly the opposite. It doesn’t matter, helping people gives me purpose and, even if no one sees it, I’ll keep doing it."'

Another user asked him why he wasn't doing more for Greenville , in North Carolina, where he grew up and where his company is headquartered. Donaldson replied: "If I listed everything we do locally, it wouldn't fit in this tweet".

The project is part of the goals of Beast Philanthropy, Donaldson's nonprofit organization . These include eradicating child labor in Ghana, bringing clean drinking water to millions of people, delivering more than 48 million meals, and planting more than 25 million trees.

articles.title: Megan Fox Is Skeptical of the Relationship Between MGK and Dakota Johnson: “She’s Not Sure He’s Mature Enough”
articles.standfirst: The actress reportedly has serious doubts about her ex-partner’s ability to maintain a healthy relationship with the star of *Fifty Shades of Grey*.
articles.summary: The actress reportedly has serious doubts about her ex-partner’s ability to maintain a healthy relationship with the star of *Fifty Shades of Grey*.
articles.body:
According to reports, Megan Fox has expressed doubts about the alleged romance between Dakota Johnson and her ex-fiancé, the musician MGK, formerly known as Machine Gun Kelly.

The report comes after several weeks of rumors surrounding MGK and Johnson. The two were seen together in New York in early September and ran into each other again in Milan during Fashion Week. Neither of them has publicly confirmed that they are in a romantic relationship.

“Megan is concerned about what Dakota is getting herself into”

The “Transformers” star reportedly has “serious doubts” about whether MGK is mature enough to start a relationship with Dakota Johnson. That said, the actress hopes things work out between them, but her own experiences with the musician make her cautious.

Fox and MGK currently have a good relationship as parents to Saga, and she still cares about her ex-partner’s happiness. Although she wishes him the best , the actress would not want to go through the complicated dynamic she experienced during her relationship with the singer again.

The source also points out a difference between Dakota Johnson and MGK. Fox has reportedly heard good things about the actress and would have no problem with her being part of the musician’s inner circle. Her concern centers on Baker and his ability to maintain a stable relationship.

Megan Fox's Look That Sparked Comments on Social Media

Megan Fox set social media ablaze on August 14 with a series of photos in which she wore a tiny black latex top under an oversized green coat. The actress paired the outfit with black pants, fur boots, sunglasses, and a choker necklace. The post included the message “intellectual compatibility.”

The post was made in August, before MGK and Dakota Johnson’s public appearances began to spark new speculation.

MGK and Dakota Johnson Cross Paths in Milan

Dakota Johnson’s name was all over the news alongside MGK during Milan Fashion Week. The actress sat in the front row at the Vogue World 2026 fashion show, where the musician walked the runway as a model. Baker walked the runway in a neon orange jumpsuit by Byblos and black sneakers, while Johnson attended in a black dress and a mesh midi skirt.

Johnson’s appearance came after the two were photographed in New York getting out of a black SUV. The photos were apparently taken about a week before the fashion show and fueled rumors of a possible romance. However, there has been no public confirmation of a relationship between the two.

A Reaction from MGK That Fueled Speculation

On September 23, MGK was approached by fans while posing for photos in Milan. At that moment, someone mentioned Dakota Johnson, and the musician’s expression changed. The reaction was interpreted as another piece of the speculation, but on its own, it does not confirm a relationship.

Meanwhile, Fox and MGK’s current situations remain linked by their romantic history and by the rumors surrounding the musician. Fox and Baker were engaged, but the current situation involving MGK and Johnson remains unconfirmed. For now, the only concrete details are their public appearances in New York and Milan and the rapper’s reaction to a mention of the actress during an encounter with fans.
